Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction (never move player); E drops bomb at feet; Space/Q inert — don't retry. Death = all heart outlines empty grey + bloodied sprite. Don't confuse hopper's white X-eyed face with the player's corpse.

TECH X (observed): gained by stepping on green/white pill at two-poop room's top-hatch landing; goggles persist across rooms. Firing spawns a lingering (~1s) laser ring that grinds overlapping targets. Ring spawn offset inconsistent: ~0.1–0.28 room-heights ahead depending on direction/position — reposition player rather than spray. Opens gray metal chests when fired at; destroys poop piles (drop real '$' coins after delay). Red crack-like outlines on rocks/chests/props are ring trails, NOT damage. No effect on: '$' coins, golden keyhole wall door, shelled/armored hoppers, red-lidded chests, spike-ringed red chest, dark-room blobs/spiders, white spike rings, decorative wall cracks, bomb-headed enemies (held ring ~1.1s, nothing).

COINS/PICKUPS (observed): real coins are small golden '$' rounds, collected only by near-exact walking overlap. Blue orbs = soul hearts (+2 blue over 1 red). Heart at full hearts converts to +1 bomb. Small yellow drips/decorative flickers change no counter.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by contact or firing; drop heart and/or bomb; re-close on room re-entry. Torch-room central gray chest inside a triangular rock ring: bombing the ring opened the path, contact opened the chest. Dark chest room: corner red-lidded chests resist laser (touching one cost several hearts at once); central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed. Chests can be wedged by barrels so contact lanes are blocked — firing from the chest's height worked better (a fired-at chest showed a white slit/mark; whether that means 'open' or 'locked' is UNRESOLVED, no pickup appeared).

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast cracks/clears rock rings and rock pockets. Damages player — ~1.7s retreat still cost a heart, so retreat 2+s or leave room. Bombing white spike rings and decorative cracks did nothing.

HAZARDS (observed): dark chest room black spiders/blobs are melee chasers, laser didn't kill them in ~4s; that room repeatedly costs hearts and yields nothing without keys — AVOID. Rock-field white round-faced hoppers are extremely lethal: they phase/warp (seen teleporting to doorways), ring themselves in spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and green orbs that damage on contact, and fill the room with drifting black dot projectiles that damage on touch. A short rock-field visit previously cost 3 hearts→1. Corner torches damage on contact. Hazard hits cost 1–3 hearts. Stay 2+ tiles clear of hoppers/green blobs/dot swarms; leave at low health. NEW/UNCERTAIN: in the TNT room a rolling black bomb-faced creature disappeared and bomb count rose 01→02 — hypothesis (guess) it's a bomb pickup, not a hazard; earlier torch-room bomb-headed enemy was laser-immune and possibly explodes on contact (unresolved). NEW room (via TNT room's top trapezoid): two pink fat enemies (one spawned adjacent, presumed contact-damaging chasers — guess), a poop pile with small blue flies (flies' threat unresolved), rocks, and a gray chest-like object at the left wall.

TRANSITIONS (observed): gold trapdoors need centered sustained S; crown hatches need precise x-center and sustained W pushed from ~0.1–0.2 room-height below; standing ON the frame blocks the warp (step back down, re-center, re-approach). Trapezoid doorways need sustained walking plus fairly precise centering. In torch room, any S press near the bottom trapdoor warps down. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid → rock-field (confirmed again: step off frame, re-center below, sustained W works); tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid → torch room; tutorial RIGHT-wall doorway (y~0.47, near-exact vertical centering) → dark chest room; torch room TOP alcove (x~0.50) → tutorial; torch room BOTTOM gold trapdoor → two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch → torch room; dark chest room LEFT-wall brown doorway (~x0.24,y~0.47) → tutorial. NEW: rock-field TOP exit → TNT/barrel room (NOT tutorial). NEW: TNT room TOP trapezoid → pink-enemy rock room (bottom trapezoid there presumably back). UNRESOLVED: rock-field BOTTOM trapezoid exit to tutorial failed repeatedly despite centering, sustained S, and an enemy-distant attempt (cost a heart); hypotheses (guess): doors locked while enemies alive, exit is arrival-only, or the dark post in that doorway blocks it.

MAP (observed): Tutorial (top+bottom trapezoids, right doorway y~0.47). Below → torch room (gray chest in rock ring, 4 corner torches, poop pile, roaming bomb-headed enemy, top alcove, bottom trapdoor). Below → two-poop room (two destructible piles flanking a gray rock; right drops a coin after delay, left gave none; Tech X pill at hatch landing; only exit top hatch). Above tutorial → rock-field (many rocks, golden keyhole door left wall ~x0.19,y~0.49, hoppers, green clouds/dot swarms, bottom exit apparently blocked, top exit → TNT room). TNT room: TNT barrels line left wall and BLOCK movement lanes (left push at chest height gave no movement; passable one row higher); two gray chests on left wall (~y0.30 upper, ~y0.63 lower) wedged among barrels; red-lidded brown barrel beside lower chest. Right of tutorial → dark chest room.

UNRESOLVED: what opens golden keyhole door and red-lidded/spiked chests (no key ever seen; HUD always 00); whether rock-field bottom exit works; what the dark post in that doorway is; whether fired-at chest's white mark = open/locked; whether blue flies hurt; source of keys/health drops; whether chest contents are randomized per run.

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/lasering locked or mimic chests with no key; treating laser crack outlines as damage; bombing spike rings/decorative cracks; lingering in dark chest room; close-range firing (overshoot) and long-range firing (falls short); hugging torches; exploring rock-field at 1 heart; assuming an open lane is clear (barrels, rocks block); holding laser on bomb-headed enemy; standing on hatch/trapdoor frames; approachin
